title: Postdoc
details: We are looking for postdocs in nonadiabatic dynamics / excited-state spectroscopy / cavity QED. Prior experience in quantum dynamics or electronic structure theory is preferred. Please refer to the postdoc recruitment website for further details on job requirements and the benefits package.

title: Ph.D. Student
details: We welcome applications from motivated students with a strong background in theoretical and computational chemistry. Please refer to the doctoral admissions website for further details on application requitment.

title: Master Student
details: Two types of master's students can be applied: academic masters (学术硕士) and professional masters (专业硕士). We welcome students with backgrounds in chemistry, physics, mathematics, or computer science. Please refer to the master admissions website for further details on application requitment.
